purpose: Map the v78 unemployment rule-regime signal into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system without creating a separate a-kassa app, target engine or truth layer.

mappings.product_miss: The support truth contract already distinguishes income-based ALF24 from an older ongoing pre-2025-10-01 benefit period, but public unemployment copy and older synthetic benchmarks still contain generic legacy arbetsvillkor/work-history semantics. The product therefore risks disagreeing with its own truth layer.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Use the existing person/unemployment capability only. For a newly unemployed user, prioritize registration with Arbetsförmedlingen on the first unemployed day before generic eligibility questioning. Before material rule guidance, distinguish a new/current decision from an older ongoing benefit period only when that fact can change the rule path. Replace blanket legacy arbetsvillkor/work-history assumptions with regime-aware questions. Preserve the existing unemployed+sick route and keep municipal economic assistance visible when food or housing is at risk.
mappings.truth_boundary: Feedback and natural-language discovery are never truth. Current IAF and Arbetsförmedlingen sources plus the relevant a-kassa are required for material unemployment-insurance claims. Do not guarantee eligibility, amount, sanction outcome or deadline, and do not infer the applicable rule regime only from the current calendar date.
